FAUSTO COMMERCIAL PRESENTS

A turnkey freight play in one of Southwest Broward's tightest industrial pockets: a high-cube clear-span warehouse on secured, contiguous acreage, paired with fenced open-air yard that works on its own or combines into a custom indoor-outdoor headquarters. The A-1 estate setting suits owner-users in logistics, agriculture, nursery, or equestrian use, with room to stage fleets or expand. Off US-27 with direct I-75 and I-595 access, it trims hauls to Port Everglades and Miami International and serves Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach without urban congestion. Southwest Ranches anchors an affluent trade area of ~7,800 residents near $161,000 median income. With new Class A product scarce in these core infill pockets, secured turnkey capacity like this rarely trades — available for sale or lease.

Location Advantages

  • Off US-27 with direct I-75 & I-595 to Port Everglades & PortMiami
  • Minutes to Miami International Airport & FEC Railway intermodal
  • Central to Miami-Dade, Broward & Palm Beach without urban congestion
  • FRP building 300,000 SF Class A logistics one node away — supply is tight

Property Highlights

  • Clear-span high-cube warehouse, heavy floor loads
  • Fenced yard: staging, trailer & storage
  • Secured contiguous land, room to expand
  • 3-phase power + well irrigation on site
  • A-1 zoning | Town of Southwest Ranches
